notes.subject: ba dirisa
notes.rationale: בלה e kaya go felelwa/go bophara go fela; 'go dirisa matsatsi' ke pono e e tlwaelegileng, e seng thaloso ya mokwalo ka tsela e tseneletseng

notes.subject: וברגע
notes.rationale: רגע ke 'puloso ya leitlho' — nako e khutshwane thata; Setswana 'ka segaja' a sa boloke setshwantsho sa leitlho

notes.subject: ba ya tlase kwa Sheole
notes.rationale: JPS/BSB a bala 'ka kagiso' (ובשלום ya mabokopodiso); mokwalo jaaka o ntse o re 'ka segaja'

translation: Ba dirisa matsatsi a bone ka botoka, mme ka segaja ba ya tlase kwa Sheole.
